# IntrospectiveRecursion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational process where a model iteratively applies self-analysis to its own outputs, creating a feedback loop that refines decision-making at each cycle. This enables in-network neuromorphic systems to adapt their routing and processing logic in real-time, reducing reliance on centralized training and improving edge responsiveness.
